Totals use pot_effective (header pot where present, item sum where the header is missing) and distribute_effective (header distribute where present, cut sum where the header is missing). Player and buyer names use the canonical name from the dataset.

Filters

Apply to every section

Filter suspect raids out for precise gold totals: tick Hide gold-suspect raids to keep only raids without header_missing, item_sum_mismatch, cut_sum_mismatch or no_players flags. Raids with only a truncated_items flag stay in, since they are safe for gold totals. Gold-suspect raids are still useful for attendance and item counts, not precise gold. Known worst cases are flagged, for example image 462 (cut read 9,601 versus true 1,096) and image 1210 (incomplete item list).
